messages:
Riley Park: Opening a tiny PR to modernize the "Hello, Redwood" quickstart — goals: show CLI-first auth, add Windows + PowerShell env examples, include a short 'how to debug 401' callout, swap Docker base to a slim image, and add a migration hint for the model alias rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5339
Ana Soto: Nice. Please keep the env var examples but hide them under an "Advanced / CI" collapsible so the page is cleaner for first-time devs.
Riley Park: Will do. Plan: top of page show `redwood login --api-key <KEY>` then a collapsed block with: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`, PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<KEY>"`, and a GitHub Actions snippet.
Keiko (DevEx): Can you add an EU region example for SDK init? Many customers in EU ask about region-aware endpoints. e.g. `client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")`
Riley Park: Added both `RedwoodClient()` and `RedwoodClient(region=\"eu-west-1\")` inline. Also adding a 1-line wscat example for realtime quicktests.
docs-bot: Lint check: found a broken anchor in deploy -> /guides/deploy. Please update to /learn/deploy or the new path.
Riley Park: Thanks bot  fixed the anchor to /learn/deploy/quickstart and pushed. Also replaced `node:18` with `node:18-bullseye-slim` and appended an Alpine variant as an optional note.
Ana Soto: Add a short migration helper for repos referencing `helium-v1` -> `helium`. A single-line `git grep | xargs sed` plus a macOS-safe `perl` variant would be great.
Riley Park: Added helpers: Linux: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and macOS: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i '' 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` (and an alternate `perl -pi -e` example). Keeping them collapsed under "Migration helpers".
Keiko (DevEx): One UX nit: earlier quickstart claimed "no rate limits" which is wrong. Please change to: "soft limits apply on free tier; see pricing" and link to pricing doc.
Riley Park: Fixed the wording and added a pricing link. Also included a tiny troubleshooting block: `curl -I -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and a note on clock skew or mis-scoped tokens causing 401s.
build-bot: Preview build queued for PR 5339  (staging preview when ready)
Riley Park: Pushed final tweaks (heading hierarchy + collapsed advanced panels). Will merge once preview is green and the scheduled docs deploy window opens. Thanks all! :shipit:
